editorial:
If you grew up watching Boog the grizzly bear and Elliot the one-antlered deer, you'll feel right at home with this fourth entry in the Open Season series. The story kicks off when the forest animals start hearing rumors about a werewolf lurking in the woods. Panic spreads fast, and former hunter Shaw sees his chance to reopen hunting season. Boog, Elliot, and Mr. Weenie team up to face their fears and track down the truth before the season starts again. It's a fun, silly adventure that keeps the spirit of the original alive while adding a spooky twist that kids will love.

The animation is bright and colorful, and the voice cast brings plenty of energy to the characters. The jokes land well for younger viewers, and the pacing keeps things moving without ever feeling too slow. On the downside, the story is pretty predictable, and older kids might find it a bit too simple. Still, if you're looking for a light, family-friendly movie night, this one delivers. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final act, Boog and his friends discover that the werewolf is actually just a regular wolf that got caught in a trap and looked scary in the dark. Shaw's plan to reopen hunting season falls apart when the truth comes out. The animals celebrate, the season stays closed, and Boog learns that facing your fears is easier when you have good friends by your side. Everyone goes back to enjoying the forest in peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves animated family adventures with lovable animal characters.
